data: Do the accuracies of all models increase as the ratio of external knowledge increases?

The caption states that more external knowledge corresponds to higher accuracies. The graph shows four lines representing different training set sizes, each with an upward trend as the ratio of external knowledge increases. The highest accuracy is achieved for the 100% training set, which remains relatively flat across the range of ratios. The other three lines show increasing trends, but they do not reach the same level of accuracy as the 100% training set. Therefore, the accuracies of all models generally increase as the ratio of external knowledge increases.
Final Answer: Yes
